demos.name: CustomColumnsPanel
demos.description: In the following demo, the columns panel is replaced with a custom component that represents the column groups as a nested list.

demos.name: CustomColumnMenu
demos.description: As mentioned above, the column menu is a component slot that can be recomposed easily and customized on each column as in the demo below.

demos.name: ToolbarGrid
demos.description: Pass the showToolbar prop to the component to enable the default toolbar.

demos.name: CustomToolbarGrid
demos.description: The following demo shows how to override the tooltip title of the density selector and the variant of the export button.

demos.name: CustomFooter
demos.description: - hideFooter: If true, the footer component is hidden.

demos.name: CustomPaginationGrid
demos.description: The next demo reuses GridPagination but replaces the previous and next page buttons with Pagination, which renders a dedicated button for each page.

demos.name: RowContextMenu
demos.description: The slotProps.row prop can be used to pass additional props to the row component.

demos.name: CellWithPopover
demos.description: The following demo uses the slotProps.cell prop to listen for specific events emitted by the cells.

demos.name: CustomSortIcons
demos.description: As any component slot, every icon can be customized.
